# Clocks and Alarms Online

> Clocks and Alarms Online is a premium, free suite of high-precision web-based timekeeping tools, including alarm clocks, world clocks, stopwatch timers, countdowns, and specialized meeting planners.

## Core Timekeeping Tools

- [Online Alarm Clock](https://clocksandalarmsonline.com/alarm-clock): Configure and customize alarms with multiple sound options, snooze settings, and repeat schedules.
- [World Clock](https://clocksandalarmsonline.com/world-clock): Track current time, time offsets, and daylight saving schedules across major cities worldwide.
- [Holiday Countdowns](https://clocksandalarmsonline.com/countdown): Precise, millisecond-accurate countdowns for all major global holidays. Track public, national, and religious holidays globally or by country (e.g. United States, India, United Kingdom) synchronized with global atomic time.
- [Online Stopwatch](https://clocksandalarmsonline.com/stopwatch): Millisecond-accurate stopwatch featuring lap tracking and clean split-time views.
- [Interval Timer](https://clocksandalarmsonline.com/timer): Pomodoro-ready timer with interval customization for focus sessions, workouts, and study routines.
- [World Meeting Planner](https://clocksandalarmsonline.com/meeting-planner): Easy coordination tool to find ideal meeting times across multiple time zones.
- [DST Tracker](https://clocksandalarmsonline.com/dst-tracker): Comprehensive guide to Daylight Saving Time changes and schedules globally.
- [Egg Timer](https://clocksandalarmsonline.com/egg-timer): Simple, preset-based cooking timer for kitchen and culinary time management.
- [Shared Alarm](https://clocksandalarmsonline.com/shared-alarm): Create alarm configurations that can be shared with others via unique URL links.
